subscriptionTrafficLow: No more than 10% of the subscription's traffic allowance remains.
subscriptionTrafficExhausted: The subscription's traffic allowance is exhausted.
subscriptionExpiresSoon: The subscription expires within three days.
subscriptionDeviceLimit: The subscription's device limit has been reached. Your saved configuration is unchanged. Contact the provider's support.
subscriptionHwidRequired: This subscription requires a device identifier. Enable HWID in the subscription settings and try again.
subscriptionIdentityFailed: Could not read the local subscription device identifier. Check access to the application data folder.
subscriptionValidationUnavailable: Could not validate the subscription. Check that the Mihomo core is installed and available, then try again.
subscriptionDnsFailed: Could not resolve the subscription server. Check DNS settings and try again.
subscriptionTlsFailed: Could not verify the subscription server's secure connection. Check the system date and the subscription address.
subscriptionTimedOut: The subscription request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
subscriptionHttpFailed: The subscription server returned an error. Try again later.
subscriptionAccessDenied: The subscription server denied access. Check the subscription link and account status.
subscriptionAddressBlocked: The subscription points to a prohibited address or uses an unsafe redirect.
subscriptionRedirectFailed: The subscription server returned an invalid redirect or too many redirects.
subscriptionTooLarge: The subscription exceeds the 15 MB download limit.
subscriptionInvalidFormat: The server did not return a valid Clash/Mihomo configuration. Check that the link uses the correct subscription format.
subscriptionNetworkFailed: Could not connect to the subscription server. Check your connection and proxy settings.
subscriptionProxyStopped: Start the VPN core before downloading a subscription through proxy.
subscriptionInvalidUrl: Invalid subscription address. Use an HTTP or HTTPS subscription link.
restoreBackupConfirm: Replace the current settings and profiles with this backup? The application will restart. Keep a backup of your current configuration if you want to return to it later.
tunRequiresAdmin: TUN mode requires Administrator privileges. Restart as Administrator.
invalidUserRulesMessage: Some user rules could not be processed. VPN has started without them: they are commented out in YAML and shown in gray in the profile rule editor. Open the profile rules to see the error and fix them.
